propositions: N=3000 import benchmark executes 6,000 redundant git config user.name lookups via author() in _seam.append_event, consuming 47.79s of 90s cumulative time
batch_stage_and_commit calls sweep_stale_staging once per new ticket (3,000 times) rather than once per batch, repeating staging-root scans for unpublished items and consuming 15.94s

Batch staging must sweep stale state exactly once per CREATE chunk (12 times for N=3000), not per-ticket or per-batch, while direct/reconciler callers retain existing per-call sweep defaults
